darts.setup:
# Add validate()/copy_array() helpers and silence 64-to-32 narrowing warnings
# for building OpenCC, https://github.com/s-yata/darts-clone/pull/6
%patch %(pkgdir)/6.patch

%reconfigure

dash.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-downstream-Update-default-path.patch
# TODO: Can this patch be removed? Upstream rejected it
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-main.c-initialize-smark.patch

%configure \
    --enable-glob \
    --with-libedit \
dash.install:
%make_install

# Make dash the default sh for quicker ./configure runs in boulder
%install_dir %(installroot)/usr/bin
ln -svf dash %(installroot)/usr/bin/sh

# Take ownership of the sh.1 man page
%install_dir %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/
ln -srvf %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/dash.1 %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/sh.1

subpackages.description: Library files for dav1d, the AV1 cross-platform Decoder

dbus.install:
%meson_install

# Trigger to reload dbus whenever necessary
%install_file %(pkgdir)/trigger.yaml %(installroot)/usr/share/moss/triggers/sys.d/reload_dbus.yaml

# Need to ensure /var/run becomes a symlink to /run for compatibility
%tmpfiles "# Create run/dbus directory"
%tmpfiles "d /run/dbus 0755 - - -"

# Kill dbus default enabling
rm -rf %(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants
mv %(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/system/dbus.service %(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/system/dbus-daemon.service
mv %(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/user/dbus.service %(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/user/dbus-daemon.service

subpackages.description: Library files for %(name), typically pulled in as a dependency of another package.

debugedit.check:
export CCACHE_DISABLE=1
# build-id recompute fails, likely due to our build-id patches
%make check || true

delta.install:
%cargo_install

# completions (Makefile shell-completion target)
%(cargo_target_dir)/delta --generate-completion bash | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/delta
%(cargo_target_dir)/delta --generate-completion fish | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/delta.fish
%(cargo_target_dir)/delta --generate-completion zsh | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_delta

device-quirks.install:
# Install binaries
install -v -m755 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/bin/" usr/bin/*

# Install module tweaks
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/modprobe.d/" usr/lib/modprobe.d/*
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/modules-load.d/" usr/lib/modules-load.d/*

# Install udev tweaks
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/udev/rules.d/" usr/lib/udev/rules.d/*
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/udev/hwdb.d/" usr/lib/udev/hwdb.d/*

# Install systemd units
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/user/" usr/lib/systemd/user/*
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/system/" usr/lib/systemd/system/*
install -v -m755 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/systemd/system-sleep/" usr/lib/systemd/system-sleep/*

# Install firmware
%install_dir "%(installroot)/usr/lib/firmware/"
cp -rv usr/lib/firmware/* "%(installroot)/usr/lib/firmware/"

# Install sysctl configurations
install -v -m644 -D -t "%(installroot)/usr/lib/sysctl.d/" usr/lib/sysctl.d/*

# Install scripts
%install_dir "%(installroot)/usr/share/device-quirks"
cp -rv usr/share/device-quirks/* "%(installroot)/usr/share/device-quirks/."

# Install pipewire hardware configs
%install_dir "%(installroot)/usr/share/pipewire/hardware-profiles"
cp -rv usr/share/pipewire/hardware-profiles/* "%(installroot)/usr/share/pipewire/hardware-profiles/."

# Install device-quirks config
%install_dir "%(installroot)/usr/share/defaults/etc/device-quirks/"
cp -rv etc/device-quirks/* "%(installroot)/usr/share/defaults/etc/device-quirks/."

discord.install:
_discord_root=%(libdir)/discord
_discord_install=%(installroot)/$_discord_root

%install_exe discord -t $_discord_install
%install_exe updater_bootstrap -t $_discord_install

%install_dir %(installroot)%(bindir)
ln -srv $_discord_install/discord %(installroot)/%(bindir)/discord

# Desktop file, icon
%install_file %(pkgdir)/discord.desktop %(installroot)%(datadir)/applications/discord.desktop
%install_file discord.png %(installroot)%(datadir)/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/discord.png

discount.install:
%make_install install.man install.samples

# Names are too generic
mv %(installroot)%(bindir)/makepage %(installroot)%(bindir)/discount-makepage
mv %(installroot)%(bindir)/mkd2html %(installroot)%(bindir)/discount-mkd2html
mv %(installroot)%(bindir)/theme %(installroot)%(bindir)/discount-theme
mv %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/makepage.1 %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/discount-makepage.1
mv %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/mkd2html.1 %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/discount-mkd2html.1
mv %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/theme.1 %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1/discount-theme.1

dnsmasq.setup:
# Causes severe delays otherwise
%patch %(pkgdir)/Disable-ICMP-echo-address-checking.patch

%patch %(pkgdir)/Do-not-rebuild-when-installing.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/Make-it-stateless.patch

# corresponding sysusers file installed below
sed -e 's|#define CHUSER "nobody"|#define CHUSER "dnsmasq"|' \
    -e 's|#define CHGRP "dip"|#define CHGRP "dnsmasq"|' -i src/config.h

sed -e 's|%%%%PREFIX%%%%|/usr|' -i dnsmasq.conf.example
dnsmasq.install:
%make install-i18n DESTDIR=%(installroot) PREFIX=/usr BINDIR=/usr/bin

%install_file dnsmasq.conf.example %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/%(name)/dnsmasq.conf
%install_file trust-anchors.conf -t %(installroot)/%(datadir)/dnsmasq

%install_file dbus/dnsmasq.conf %(installroot)/%(datadir)/dbus-1/system.d/uk.org.thekelleys.dnsmasq.conf
%install_file %(pkgdir)/dnsmasq.service -t %(installroot)/%(libdir)/systemd/system
%install_file %(pkgdir)/dnsmasq.sysusers %(installroot)/%(libdir)/sysusers.d/dnsmasq.conf

docbook.install:
## Setup the catalog
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/docbook/docbook-dtd/

xml_catalog="%(installroot)/%(vendordir)/docbook/docbook-dtd/catalog"
xmlcatalog --noout --create "$xml_catalog"

for ver in 4.1.2 4.2 4.3 %(version); do
    mkdir docbook-xml-${ver}
    unzip -d docbook-xml-${ver} %(sourcedir)/${ver}.zip

    pushd docbook-xml-${ver}
    %install_dir %(installroot)/%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xml-dtd-${ver}
    cp -dr docbook.cat *.dtd ent/ *.mod %(installroot)/%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xml-dtd-${ver}

    # Inspired by Arch
    case $ver in
        4.1.2) xml=' XML' ;;&
        *)
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//DTD DocBook XML V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/docbookx.dtd" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//DTD DocBook$xml CALS Table Model V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/calstblx.dtd" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//DTD XML Exchange Table Model 19990315//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/soextblx.dtd" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//ELEMENTS DocBook$xml Information Pool V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/dbpoolx.mod" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//ELEMENTS DocBook$xml Document Hierarchy V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/dbhierx.mod" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//ENTITIES DocBook$xml Additional General Entities V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/dbgenent.mod" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//ENTITIES DocBook$xml Notations V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/dbnotnx.mod" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//ENTITIES DocBook$xml Character Entities V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/dbcentx.mod" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            ;;&
        4.[45])
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "public" \
                "-//OASIS//ELEMENTS DocBook XML HTML Tables V${ver}//EN" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}/htmltblx.mod" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            ;;&
        *)
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "rewriteSystem" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}" \
                "/usr/share/xml/docbook/xml-dtd-${ver}" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "rewriteURI" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${ver}" \
                "/usr/share/xml/docbook/xml-dtd-${ver}" \
                "$xml_catalog"
            ;;&
    esac
done

docbook-xsl.setup:
for i in docbook-xsl-nons docbook-xsl-ns; do
    pushd $i
    %patch %(pkgdir)/no-stack-overflow.patch
    popd
done
docbook-xsl.install:
for i in nons ns; do
    case $i in
        nons) ns="-nons" ;;
        ns) ns="" ;;
    esac
    versioned_dir="xsl-stylesheets$ns-%(version)"
    destdir="%(installroot)/%(datadir)/xml/docbook/$versioned_dir"

    pushd docbook-xsl-$i
    install -Dt "$destdir" -m644 VERSION{,.xsl}
    (
    shopt -s nullglob
    for fn in assembly common eclipse epub epub3 fo highlighting html \
        htmlhelp javahelp lib manpages params profiling roundtrip template \
        website xhtml xhtml-1_1 xhtml5
    do
        install -Dt "$destdir/$fn" -m644 $fn/*.{xml,xsl,dtd,ent}
    done
    )

    popd
    # Unversioned directory for compatibility
    ln -sv $versioned_dir %(installroot)/%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets$ns
done

## Catalog
%install_dir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/docbook/docbook-xsl/
xml_catalog="%(installroot)/%(vendordir)/docbook/docbook-xsl/catalog"
xmlcatalog --noout --create "$xml_catalog"

for v in %(version) current; do
    for x in rewriteSystem rewriteURI; do
        xmlcatalog --noout --add $x \
            "http://cdn.docbook.org/release/xsl/$v" \
            "%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-%(version)" \
            "$xml_catalog"
        xmlcatalog --noout --add $x \
            "http://cdn.docbook.org/release/xsl-nons/$v" \
            "%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-nons-%(version)" \
            "$xml_catalog"
        xmlcatalog --noout --add $x \
            "http://docbook.sourceforge.net/release/xsl-ns/$v" \
            "%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-%(version)" \
            "$xml_catalog"
        xmlcatalog --noout --add $x \
            "http://docbook.sourceforge.net/release/xsl/$v" \
            "%(datadir)/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-nons-%(version)" \
            "$xml_catalog"
    done
done

    # "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/sch/docbook.sch" \
    # "file://${_datadir}/xml/docbook/schema/sch/${v}/docbook.sch" ${_catalog51}

    # ---------------------
    # Build XML catalog files for each Schema
    for s in rng sch; do
        _schema_catalog=${s}/catalog.xml
        xmlcatalog --noout --create ${_schema_catalog}
        case $s in
            sch)
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/${s}/docbook.${s}" \
                "docbook.${s}" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${v}/${s}/docbook.${s}" \
                "docbook.${s}" ${_schema_catalog}
            ;;
            rng)
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/${s}/docbook.${s}" \
                "docbook.${s}" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${v}/${s}/docbook.${s}" \
                "docbook.${s}" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/${s}/docbookxi.${s}" \
                "docbookxi.${s}" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${v}/${s}/docbookxi.${s}" \
                "docbookxi.${s}" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/${s}/docbook.rnc" \
                "docbook.rnc" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${v}/${s}/docbook.rnc" \
                "docbook.rnc" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/${s}/docbookxi.rnc" \
                "docbookxi.rnc" ${_schema_catalog}
            xmlcatalog --noout --add "uri" \
                "http://www.oasis-open.org/docbook/xml/${v}/${s}/docbookxi.rnc" \
                "docbookxi.rnc" ${_schema_catalog}
            ;;
        esac
    done
done
popd
docbook5-xml.install:
_docbook5dir="%(installroot)%(datadir)/xml/docbook"

# docbook-5.0
pushd "5.0"
for v in 5.0; do
    for type in dtd rng sch xsd; do
        %install_file ${type}/* -t ${_docbook5dir}/schema/${type}/${v}
    done
done
popd

# docbook-5.1
pushd 5.1
for v in 5.1; do
    for type in rng sch; do
        %install_file ${type}/* -t ${_docbook5dir}/schema/${type}/${v}
    done
done
popd

%install_dir %(installroot)/%(vendordir)/docbook/docbook5-xml/
xml_catalog="%(installroot)/%(vendordir)/docbook/docbook5-xml/catalog"
xmlcatalog --noout --create "$xml_catalog"
for v in 5.{0,1}; do
  xmlcatalog --noout --add "delegatePublic" \
    "-//OASIS//DTD DocBook XML ${v}//EN" \
    "file://%(datadir)/xml/docbook/schema/dtd/${v}/catalog.xml" \
    ${xml_catalog}
  xmlcatalog --noout --add "delegateSystem" \
    "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/dtd/" \
    "file://%(datadir)/xml/docbook/schema/dtd/${v}/catalog.xml" \
    ${xml_catalog}
  xmlcatalog --noout --add "delegateURI" \
    "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/dtd/" \
    "file://%(datadir)/xml/docbook/schema/dtd/${v}/catalog.xml" \
    ${xml_catalog}
  xmlcatalog --noout --add "delegateURI" \
    "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/rng/"  \
    "file://%(datadir)/xml/docbook/schema/rng/${v}/catalog.xml" \
    ${xml_catalog}
  xmlcatalog --noout --add "delegateURI" \
    "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/sch/"  \
    "file://%(datadir)/xml/docbook/schema/sch/${v}/catalog.xml" \
    ${xml_catalog}
  xmlcatalog --noout --add "delegateURI" \
    "http://docbook.org/xml/${v}/xsd/"  \
    "file://%(datadir)/xml/docbook/schema/xsd/${v}/catalog.xml" \
    ${xml_catalog}
done

docker.build:
cd src/github.com/docker/cli
export GOPATH=${PWD}
export GO111MODULE=auto

export GOFLAGS="-buildmode=pie -trimpath -mod=readonly -modcacherw -ldflags=-linkmode=external"

# Git commit corresponding to the version tag
export GITCOMMIT=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/docker/cli.git refs/tags/v%(version)^{} | awk '{print $1}')
export DOCKER_GITCOMMIT=${GITCOMMIT}

# Docker is meant to be built inside a container and will exit with an error if this isn't set.
export DISABLE_WARN_OUTSIDE_CONTAINER=1

# build docker-cli
%make dynbinary \
    VERSION=%(version) \
    PLATFORM="Docker Engine - Community"

# man pages
make manpages
docker.install:
# docker-cli
%install_exe build/docker-linux-amd64 %(installroot)/%(bindir)/docker

# man pages
%install_file man/man1/*.1 -t %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1
%install_file man/man5/*.5 -t %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man5

# completions
%install_file contrib/completion/bash/docker %(installroot)/%(completionsdir)/docker
%install_file contrib/completion/zsh/_docker %(installroot)/%(datadir)/zsh/site-functions/_docker
%install_file contrib/completion/fish/docker.fish %(installroot)/%(datadir)/fish/vendor_completions.d/docker.fish

docker-buildx.build:
# Git commit corresponding to the version tag
GITCOMMIT=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/docker/buildx "refs/tags/v%(version)^{}" | awk '{print $1}')

_xflags="-X ${_buildx_r}/version.Version=v%(version) -X ${_buildx_r}/version.Revision=${GITCOMMIT} -X ${_buildx_r}/version.Package=${_buildx_r}"
export GOFLAGS="$(echo "${GOFLAGS}" | sed "s#-ldflags=[^ ]*#\"& ${_xflags}\"#")"

go build -o docker-buildx ./cmd/buildx

docker-compose.build:
export GO111MODULE=auto

export GOFLAGS+=" -ldflags=-X=${_compose_r}/v5/internal.Version=v%(version)"
